_comment: Unpredictable Cyclone phase 3: a cycle seed in a mid-turn CONTINUATION -- Brainstorm draws the Street
Wraith, then the Wraith is cycled the same turn. Round 3, main 1, Cyclone + three Islands, Brainstorm in
hand; the library top is Street Wraith, Island, Island, Emrakul. Brainstorm draws the Wraith and two Islands
